descriptions.text: Bitcoin exchange Bitfloor suspended operations after the theft of $250,000. The founder Roman Shtylman explained in a post on the Bitcoin Forum that an attacker obtained an unencrypted backup of exchange wallet keys and used these keys to transfer "BitFloor on hand" Most of the coins he held," Shtilman later locked this part of the money at around 24,000 BTC.

Bitfloor, a Bitcoin exchange, was exploited in September 2012 when attackers accessed an unencrypted backup containing wallet private keys, resulting in the theft of approximately 24,000 BTC (then around $250,000). Attackers gained access to an unencrypted backup file containing wallet private keys due to poor operational security.
